look: Glasswing Stinger, a D-rank GKOM variant from the Glasswings family: fist-sized wasp with a green glass stinger. Family anatomy: insects with wings of beaten green glass and needle stingers. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: GKOM crystals crust its joints and run along the spine; about a quarter of the body crystallised; the crystals are green bottle-glass crystal. Element Wind: teal, pale green and silver accents, modest spiralling leaves, gust lines and floating feathers
